tutorial.welcome_subtitle:
Studying is not about feeling, it's about data.
Step up with your own data.
tutorial.slide1_desc: Increase immersion by selecting a space that suits your learning purpose.
tutorial.slide1_f1_desc: Custom settings for school, academy, library, etc.
tutorial.slide1_f2_desc: Move between spaces quickly according to the situation
tutorial.slide2_desc: Measure and record only the actual time spent studying precisely.
tutorial.slide2_f1_desc: AI timer that picks out only focused time
tutorial.slide2_f2_desc: Measured time is immediately reflected in statistics
tutorial.slide3_desc: Divide study time by subject to maintain balance.
tutorial.slide3_f1_desc: Switch timers by subject with one click
tutorial.slide3_f2_desc: Freely add subjects you are studying
tutorial.slide4_desc: On class days, press the 'Check-in' button on the home screen. Attendance is automatically recorded and shared with academies and parents.
tutorial.slide4_f1_desc: Complete with a single button on the class card
tutorial.slide4_f2_desc: Attendance rates and lateness statistics are automatically aggregated
tutorial.slide5_desc: Enter the exam code shared by your teacher into 'New Exam' to start immediately. You can solve it instantly without paper exam sheets.
tutorial.slide5_f1_desc: Start at once with the code received from your teacher
tutorial.slide5_f2_desc: Check results and explanations immediately after solving
tutorial.slide6_desc: Solve problems like a real exam with OMR card format.
tutorial.slide6_f1_desc: Easy entry just like actual OMR marking
tutorial.slide6_f2_desc: Check results immediately after the exam ends
tutorial.slide7_desc: Solve selected high-quality problems anytime, anywhere.
tutorial.slide7_f1_desc: Search for problems by difficulty and unit
tutorial.slide7_f2_desc: Manage the problems you solved in your library
tutorial.slide8_desc: We analyze exam results precisely with various charts.
tutorial.slide8_f1_desc: AI analyzes which areas are lacking
tutorial.slide8_f2_desc: Check grade change graphs over time
tutorial.slide9_desc: Manage incorrect problems easily by taking photos.
tutorial.slide9_f1_desc: Register incorrect answers immediately by taking photos
tutorial.slide9_f2_desc: Notifications to re-solve before you forget
tutorial.slide10_desc: Check your growth through data that accumulates every day.
tutorial.slide10_f2_desc: Check the achievement rate of set study goals
tutorial.slide11_desc: Ask questions about problems you are curious about and communicate with friends.
tutorial.slide11_f1_desc: Ask questions to the community immediately for problems you don't know
tutorial.final_subtitle:
Start smart learning with StudyPeak
right now!
